#en: All right. Ready for me to proceed, or do you need a moment to consider?
zh: 好。要我继续吗，还是你需要再考虑一下？

#en: But, he said all he wanted was a spot for him and a few friends to stay.
zh: 但他说他只想找个地方，让他和几个朋友待着。

#en: [Hand in all Intel] I found more than one slate. Here's all that I have.
zh: [递交全部情报] 我找到不止一块数据板。这是我有的全部。

#en: Alright, I'm done. Intel pointed to a Listening Post in a nearby system.
zh: 好，完成了。情报指向附近星系的一处监听哨。

#en: Huh. Okay, that was a novel way to deal with the situation. Well played!
zh: 哦。行，这处理方式挺新颖。干得漂亮！

#en: Make your way into the facility. I'll link up with you soon as I'm able!
zh: 你想办法进设施。我尽快跟你会合！

#en: Focus on the scan. I'll make sure those drones don't catch us off guard.
zh: 专心扫描。我保证那些无人机不会打我们个措手不及。

#en: ...Hey. I'm detecting incoming ships. They're small. Look like drones...
zh: ……嘿。我探测到来袭飞船。很小。像是无人机……

#en: You must have some way to counter it, otherwise why ask me to come here?
zh: 你肯定有办法对付它，不然干吗叫我来？

#en: I'm a full-fledged Freestar Ranger. It's a duty that makes you a target.
zh: 我是正式的星联游骑兵。这身份会让你成为目标。

#en: I am a prominent UC citizen, and know some fairly sensitive information.
zh: 我是联殖的重要公民，知道一些相当敏感的情报。

#en: Just checked. Sorry, nothing left to launch. So that's a firm no-can-do.
zh: 刚查过。抱歉，没得发射了。所以是明确的办不到。

#en: I'm sorry, I can't confirm your identity. Ready yourself for processing.
zh: 抱歉，我无法确认你的身份。准备接受处理。

#en: Me, personally? No. Never even knew they existed until a few months back.
zh: 我个人？没有。几个月前才知道他们存在。

#en: But, so long as you don't cause trouble, my docking bays are always open.
zh: 不过，只要你不惹麻烦，我的船坞永远敞开。

#en: This is the person I told you about, Harper. The one I was looking for...
zh: 这就是我跟你说过的人，哈珀。我要找的那个……

#en: You'll need a few more credits before I can provide treatment, I'm sorry.
zh: 抱歉，你得再多些钱我才能给你治疗。

#en: I have Amps, medical supplies... Just be sure to have your credits ready.
zh: 我有增幅、医疗物资……记得把钱备好。

#en: I don't think there are any more Skydrops to discover. You have them all.
zh: 我想没有别的空投可发现了。你已经全都有了。

#en: This slate contains the schematics I can retrieve. Review and select one.
zh: 这块数据板上有我能调取的图纸。看看，挑一个。

#en: You've already destroyed every Listening Post. There's no more to locate!
zh: 你已经摧毁了所有监听哨。没得找了！

#en: Slate's toast. But it did reveal a Listening Post is in a distant system.
zh: 数据板废了。但它确实指明了远处星系有处监听哨。

#en: I'll regulate things from here. You flip those switches! Fast as you can!
zh: 我在这儿调控。你去扳开关！越快越好！

#en: Right you are! Let's head back to your ship. Your turn to play chauffeur.
zh: 说得对！我们回你的飞船。该你当司机了。

#en: ...Wait. I think I got a plan. Stay here, and get behind some damn cover!
zh: ……等等。我有个主意。待在这儿，找该死的掩体躲好！

#en: It's a new universe, so I figured we should give the Stardock a new name.
zh: 这是新宇宙，我想我们该给星坞起个新名字。

#en: Nope! Lightly tenderized, maybe. I did get knocked around a little bit...
zh: 没有！大概只是被轻轻捶了一顿。我确实被撞得不轻……

#en: Good to know you, Torin. I'm <Alias=Player>. I appreciate you helping me.
zh: 很高兴认识你，托林。我是<Alias=Player>。谢谢你帮我。

#en: *crunch* Okay, brace yourself. Not sure I fully trust these things yet...
zh: *嘎吱* 好，稳住。我还不确定完全信得过这些东西……

#en: But your little deal is with a completely different branch of Watchtower.
zh: 但跟你打交道的是瞭望塔完全不同的分支。

#en: Look, I get that you have some sort of "understanding" with these guys...
zh: 听着，我明白你跟这些人有某种「默契」……

#en: But with a little love, and a lot of welding, we got it into decent shape.
zh: 但凭着一点爱心和大量焊接，我们把它修得还算像样。

#en: You should ask Harper about it. She knows more about this place than I do.
zh: 你该去问哈珀。这地方她比我熟。

#en: I-... Well, okay! As long as you understand -- and try not to do it again.
zh: 我——……好吧，行！只要你明白——然后尽量别再犯。

#en: Ah, you're exaggerating! It's not "every time". Besides, B.A.B.S was here!
zh: 啊，你夸大其词！又不是「每次」。再说，B.A.B.S. 当时在呢！

#en: Oh, yes... I can see it now. Not good! We'll need to treat that right now.
zh: 哦，对……我看到了。不太妙！我们得马上处理。

#en: Hard part over, data is extracted. Now, it's just a matter of building it.
zh: 难的部分过去了，数据已提取。现在只剩建造。

#en: I often found myself in government installations, or corporate facilities.
zh: 我常出入政府设施，或企业场所。

#en: Build is complete. We can fit the Skydrop to a ship whenever you're ready.
zh: 建造完成。你准备好就能把空投装到船上。

#en: Skydrop module is finished. If you want it fitted to a ship, say the word.
zh: 空投模块已完成。想装到船上就说一声。

#en: Ah, good! There you are. Now, where was I...? Ah, right. The spy Arrays...
zh: 啊，好！你在这儿。我说到哪儿了……？啊，对了。那些间谍阵列……

#en: [Moderate] Find me a system that's just enough to keep things interesting.
zh: [中等] 给我找个刚好能保持趣味度的星系。

#en: I've sent what we extracted to your nav. Good luck with your Post hunting!
zh: 我把提取到的都发到你导航了。祝你找监听哨顺利！

#en: Alright, on your feet! We done playing? Lockdown will be lifted, let's go.
zh: 好，起来！玩够了没？封锁要解除了，走吧。

#en: One more time! If you wanna zap that mech, flip the power switches for me!
zh: 再来一次！想电那台机甲，就帮我把电源开关扳上！

#en: Lining up my trajectory. You'll want to get clear before I ram this thing!
zh: 正在校准轨迹。我撞上去之前你最好躲开！

#en: Facility located! Shockingly, still under ice, so it's Skydrop or nothing!
zh: 找到设施了！没想到，还在冰层下，所以要么空投要么没戏！

#en: There's the target. Icebound as ever. Skydrop should crack it open nicely.
zh: 目标在那儿。还是冰封着。空投应该能漂亮地把它撬开。

#en: Unless there are other Watchtower ships nearby, which I doubt, we're safe.
zh: 除非附近还有别的瞭望塔飞船，我看不太可能，我们安全。

#en: But no problem! That's why we've got Skydrop! All we'll need to do is--...
zh: 但没问题！所以才要空投啊！我们只需要——……

#en: Uh, yeah... that's a negative. I don't have a clear signal from the flair.
zh: 呃，是啊……不行。我收不到信号弹的清晰信号。

#en: I was warned you may not be what I expected. Still, I didn't expect this...
zh: 有人提醒过我，你可能跟我想的不一样。但我也没想到会是这样……

#en: Well, okay. So long as you don't do it again. Glad you rescued your friend.
zh: 好吧。只要你别再犯。很高兴你救出了朋友。

#en: Truth be told, it's still a new concept to me. But, as I understand them...
zh: 说实话，这对我也还是新概念。但据我理解……

#en: Alright, give me a moment to crack the security and extract what we need...
zh: 好，给我一点时间破解安全系统，提取我们需要的东西……

#en: Process is complete. You're free to request this Skydrop whenever you want.
zh: 流程完成。你随时都能调用这个空投。

#en: Finished. The Skydrop schematic is ready. Let me know if you want it built.
zh: 完成。空投图纸已就绪。想建造就告诉我。

#en: I'll do my best to help. And we should consider installing a built Skydrop.
zh: 我会尽力帮忙。我们也该考虑装一个造好的空投。

#en: Done. The system upgrade will allow you to commission an additional vessel.
zh: 完成。系统升级后你能多订造一艘船。

#en: Wait, before you go! I've been thinking some more about those spy Arrays...
zh: 等等，走之前！我又想了想那些间谍阵列……

#en: Just gimme some time to make the call and let my contacts do their thing...
zh: 给我点时间打个招呼，让我的关系网去办事……

#en: But, hey! The mech's outta commission! See? Nothing but fried circuits now.
zh: 不过，嘿！机甲报废了！看？现在只剩烧焦的电路。

#en: And here's me without a ship again! Guess I'll be catching a ride with you.
zh: 又轮到我没了飞船！看来得搭你的车了。

#en: And... there's the facility! Still under ice, so we'll have to use Skydrop.
zh: 然后……设施在那儿！还在冰层下，所以只能靠空投。

#en: I've lost track of how many times we've done this but, um, let's get to it!
zh: 我都记不清做过多少次了，不过，呃，开始吧！

#en: Oh-ho-ho! Don't I know it! I've not forgotten how you handled thaaaaat--...
zh: 哦哈哈哈！我当然知道！我可没忘记你是怎么处理那——……

#en: Well that one, I can answer. You see, I was already on the lookout for you.
zh: 这个我倒能回答。你看，我本来就在留意你。

#en: Nice job, as always. You'd think they would've learned by now, wouldn't ya?
zh: 一如既往地干得好。你以为他们该学乖了，是吧？

#en: So here! Your payment. And some advice... You need to be careful out there.
zh: 给你！你的报酬。还有句忠告……你在外面得小心点。

#en: Just be ready for Watchtower to show up, the moment you start pokin' around.
zh: 你一动手打探，就得准备好瞭望塔会冒出来。

#en: *sigh* I'll let it slide this time. Your friend's safe, that's what matters.
zh: *叹气* 这次就算了。你朋友安全，这才是要紧的。

#en: ...So, how was your supply run? Those Surgeon guys have everything you need?
zh: ……那么，补给跑得怎么样？那些医师那儿有你需要的吗？

#en: I'm still not an expert in this tech, but I've always enjoyed a challenge...
zh: 我对这技术还不算内行，但我一向喜欢挑战……

#en: I assume it's how they keep their reach broad and their actions untraceable.
zh: 我猜这就是他们触角广、行动又查不到踪迹的原因。

#en: Done. Data is extracted. You can now request this Skydrop whenever you like.
zh: 完成。数据已提取。你现在随时都能调用这个空投。

#en: If you are interested, we can build a Skydrop before modifying your ship...?
zh: 如果你愿意，改装飞船前我们可以先造个空投……？

#en: I can extract the schematics for this Skydrop. Is this your final selection?
zh: 我可以提取这个空投的图纸。这是你的最终选择吗？

#en: The Fleet Command System has been enhanced, allowing for greater fleet size.
zh: 舰队指挥系统已强化，可容纳更大的舰队。

#en: Hold on, I've changed my mind. I'd prefer a different degree of challenge...
zh: 等等，我改主意了。我想换个难度……

#en: I can manage that. But first, are we aiming for an easy ride or a challenge?
zh: 这我能办。但先问一句，我们要轻松的还是挑战？

#en: Don't forget about the mech! Once it emerges, I'll take it out with my ship.
zh: 别忘了那台机甲！它一露面，我就用飞船干掉它。

#en: Thought it a good idea to skip the Watchtower ambush and come straight here.
zh: 我想着跳过瞭望塔的伏击，直接来这儿比较好。

#en: Make sure you keep warm! Conditions down there don't seem overly hospitable.
zh: 注意保暖！下面的环境看起来不太友好。

#en: Ah, too late! I'm detecting... It's a ship, it's jumping in! Weapons ready!!
zh: 啊，太晚了！我探测到……是飞船，正在跃迁进来！武器准备！！

#en: Oh, I'm sure we'll be able to find what you need. Thanks for your time, Gren!
zh: 哦，我肯定我们能找到你要的。多谢你抽时间，格伦！

#en: After all the sweat you put in, pfft, it's not as if I'd just blow it all up!
zh: 你费了那么多心血，噗，我总不能全给炸了吧！

#en: Please, have a seat, help yourself to a snack or drink. This won't take long.
zh: 请坐，随便吃点喝点。不会太久。

#en: Nothing we weren't expecting! Well, there was one thing, but other than that.
zh: 都在预料之中！嗯，有一件事例外，除此之外没什么。

#en: I don't care if you're intrigued or not. Question is, are you up to the task?
zh: 我不在乎你感不感兴趣。问题是你干得了这活吗？

#en: Okay. Take another look at the slate and let me know what catches your eye...
zh: 好。再看看数据板，告诉我哪个合你意……

#en: The ship you flagged has been processed. Here's the credits from the salvage.
zh: 你标记的飞船已处理完。这是拆解所得的钱。

#en: Sending the details your way. Up to you if you wanna check it out. Take care.
zh: 把详情发给你了。想不想去看看随你。保重。

#en: Oh, I'd love to! But looks like we don't have enough to pay for her services.
zh: 哦，我很想！但看来我们的钱不够付她的服务费。

#en: Okay, then. Power up your Grav Drive and take point! I'll be right behind ya.
zh: 那好。启动重力推动器，你打头！我紧随其后。

#en: Now you're talking my language! I'll take any advantage I can get in a fight.
zh: 这才对嘛！打架时能占的便宜我都占。

#en: I have an... association with the Crimson Fleet. Let's just leave it at that.
zh: 我跟深红舰队有点……关系。就说到这儿吧。

#en: Hm. I see the flare, but I can't drop anything where you've parked it. Sorry!
zh: 嗯。我看到信号弹了，但你停在那儿我没法投东西。抱歉！

#en: Alright, we are in a new universe, but we're gonna follow the same game plan.
zh: 好，我们身处新宇宙，但还是照老计划来。

#en: Please, feel free to ask any questions you might have. I'll answer what I can.
zh: 有什么问题尽管问。能答的我都答。

#en: No need to be shy, Gren. I've already explained about you being ex-Watchtower.
zh: 别不好意思，格伦。我已经解释过你是前瞭望塔成员。

#en: No issue at all. Give the slate another glance, and tell me what you'd like...
zh: 完全没问题。再看看数据板，告诉我你要什么……

#en: Hello again. Have you reconsidered installing a Skydrop system to your vessel?
zh: 又见面了。考虑好给你的船装空投系统了吗？

#en: Haha, no. I still feel emotions. But... they're less intense, more structured.
zh: 哈哈，不是。我仍能感受情绪。只是……没那么强烈，更有条理。

#en: Okay, I'm finished. Looks like... the Listening Post is practically next door!
zh: 好，完成了。看来……那监听哨几乎就在隔壁！

#en: Quit it! Those shields are too strong! If anything, you're just making it mad!
zh: 别打了！那些护盾太强了！你这样只会把它惹毛！

#en: Setting my course. You'll wanna be nowhere near that mech when I make contact!
zh: 设定航线。我撞上时你最好离那台机甲远远的！

#en: Well, it's chilly! But you won't freeze to death. Your scan told us that much.
zh: 嗯，挺冷的！但不会冻死。你的扫描至少说明了这点。

#en: First of all, congratulations, Ranger! You're a credit to the Settled Systems!
zh: 首先，恭喜你，游骑兵！你是定居星系的骄傲！

#en: Not a bad way to kick things off! And nice to be back in the old Perseverance.
zh: 开局不错！回到老坚毅号的感觉真好。

#en: Cracking algorithm worked like a charm! This Intel Slate holds a lot of data...
zh: 破解算法效果绝佳！这块情报数据板里数据很多……

#en: Well, I suppose that's why you have a fleet! If... two ships counts as a fleet.
zh: 嗯，我想这就是你养舰队的原因！如果……两艘船算舰队的话。

#en: Just an option to keep in mind, that's all. Now, can I help you with something?
zh: 只是给你个选项参考，没别的。那么，有什么能帮你的吗？

#en: Just select another ship from your fleet and we can install the Skydrop system.
zh: 从你的舰队里另选一艘船，我们就能装空投系统。

#en: Shall I retrieve the data for this Skydrop? Or would you prefer something else?
zh: 要我调取这个空投的数据吗？还是你想要别的？

#en: Sit tight. I'll reach out to some folks, give them time to dig up what we need.
zh: 别急。我联系几个人，给他们点时间去挖我们需要的东西。

#en: Good start! Power's started flowing, but we'll still need more. Don't stop now!
zh: 开头不错！电力开始流了，但还需要更多。别停下！

#en: There they are! I'm detecting the Watchtower drones inbound. Ah! Right on time.
zh: 它们来了！我探测到瞭望塔无人机来袭。啊！真准时。

#en: Alright, let's handle these drones, then get ourselves to the planet's surface!
zh: 好，先收拾这些无人机，然后我们去行星表面！

#en: Now, call me crazy, but I don't think my ship is gonna be flying any time soon.
zh: 你可以说我疯了，但我觉得我的飞船一时半会儿飞不了。

#en: Your weapons won't scratch it. And we just used our only Skydrop. Shit. Shit...
zh: 你的武器伤不了它。而我们刚用掉唯一的空投。该死。该死……

#en: You alright down there? Throw the flare at the exposed section of the facility.
zh: 你在下面没事吧？把信号弹扔向设施暴露的部分。

#en: That's why we need this Control Node. Otherwise, none of this is going to work.
zh: 所以我们需要这个控制节点。否则这一切都行不通。

#en: What would you do without me? Be rotting away in Heimdall Station, most likely!
zh: 没我你怎么办？多半会烂在海姆达尔站里！

#en: The Altair system? That's barely a jump away... Hmph. No wonder you're agitated.
zh: 牵牛星系？那也就一次跃迁的距离……哼。难怪你心烦。

#en: Simple, really. It helps keep me safe and well. And not just because it's armor.
zh: 很简单。它能让我安全健康。不只是因为它算盔甲。

#en: Just need to put out a feeler. Someone out there's bound to find what we want...
zh: 只要放个风声出去。总会有人找到我们要的东西……

#en: Alright, I'll scout for one. But first, how much heat are you willing to handle?
zh: 好，我去找一处。但先问，你能承受多大的风险？

#en: Why power up the Disruptor when you can just cut power to the mech? Haha. Smart.
zh: 能直接切断机甲电源，何苦去给干扰器通电？哈哈。聪明。

#en: Down you go to the surface! I'll stay here and ensure Skydrop's ready to deploy.
zh: 你下到地表去！我留在这儿确保空投随时可部署。

#en: Down to the surface with you! I'll manage things up here and get Skydrop set up.
zh: 你下到地表去！我在这儿管着，把空投准备好。

#en: And there they are. I'm detecting Watchtower drones inbound. Heh. Right on time.
zh: 它们来了。我探测到瞭望塔无人机来袭。嘿。真准时。

#en: Eridani III. Fleet-Sync Control Node. I'll be in my ship, waiting for your hail!
zh: 波江座III。舰队同步控制节点。我在飞船里等你的呼叫！

#en: I recently touched an Artifact and had visions. Could that be why I'm dangerous?
zh: 我最近碰过一件神器，还看到了幻象。这就是我危险的原因吗？

#en: I've been to Va'ruun'kai, home to House Va'ruun. And I know how to travel there.
zh: 我去过瓦鲁凯星，瓦鲁家族的家园。而且我知道怎么去。

#en: Beginning: Resource Collection. Organic life forms must maintain their distance.
zh: 开始：资源采集。有机生命体必须保持距离。

#en: Huh. Turns out you picked the drop I'm completely out of. Figures, right? Sorry.
zh: 哦。你挑的偏偏是我完全没有的那种空投。意料之中，对吧？抱歉。

#en: *crunch* Strike coming right up. Don't wander too close to the blast zone, okay?
zh: *嘎吱* 打击马上到。别晃悠到离爆炸区太近，好吗？

#en: But don't worry! It'll wear off! Eventually... Just, try not to strain yourself.
zh: 但别担心！会消退的！总会……只是，别太用力。

#en: Well now, thanks for inviting me! Always happy to put Watchtower in their place.
zh: 哎呀，谢谢邀请我！我向来乐意让瞭望塔认清自己的位置。

#en: [Hand over Intel] I've taken care of it. Here, a slate with the Intel you wanted.
zh: [交出情报] 我办好了。给，你要的情报数据板。

#en: Let me know if you need a hand. Otherwise, I'll stay here. Keep an eye on things.
zh: 需要帮忙就说。不然我就留在这儿，盯着点。

#en: There's no big rush, I suppose. Not like the Listening Post is gonna go anywhere.
zh: 我想也不用太急。监听哨又不会跑。

#en: And best of all, here? I make the rules. Sleep a helluva lot better knowing that.
zh: 最棒的是，在这儿？规矩我定。知道这点睡得香多了。

#en: There's no need to be delicate, Torin. I won't be offended. We can speak plainly.
zh: 不用绕弯子，托林。我不会介意。我们直说就好。

#en: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Hold on, now... No need to panic! Gren's one of us.
zh: 哇！哇哇哇哇。等等……不用慌！格伦是我们自己人。

#en: Most people living there either work the mines or the industries supporting them.
zh: 住那儿的人大多在矿场干活，或从事配套产业。

#en: The Fleet Command System is upgraded. You can now add another ship to your fleet.
zh: 舰队指挥系统已升级。你现在可以再添一艘船。

#en: Sure, I'll try. How dangerous are we talkin'? You want easy pickings, or a fight?
zh: 行，我试试。有多危险？你想要轻松活儿，还是硬仗？

#en: Anomalies in Corvette control system. Containment protocols engaged; area sealed.
zh: 护卫舰控制系统出现异常。收容协议已启动；区域已封锁。

#en: I'll get the corvette's Synapse Distuper prepped. You go get me the power I need!
zh: 我去把护卫舰的突触干扰器准备好。你去把我要的电送上！

#en: Huh. That, um, that was a bit "doom and gloom" of me, wasn't it? Uh... Alright...
zh: 哦。这，呃，我这话有点太悲观了，是吧？呃……好吧……

#en: Your choice. But it'll be here, ready for installation, if you change your mind...
zh: 随你。但你要是改主意，它就在这儿，随时能装……

#en: Assigning a pilot is easy. Just use the terminal again, you should see the option.
zh: 分配飞行员很简单。再用一次终端，你就能看到选项。

#en: Ooh, I wouldn't mind piloting a ship! You know, if you've got no one else in mind.
zh: 哦，我倒不介意开艘船！你知道，要是你没别人选的话。

#en: Deploys a turret equipped with focused laser beams. Ideal for a sustained defense.
zh: 部署一座配备聚焦激光束的炮塔。适合持续防御。

#en: Checked the other slates as well. Pulled some more Listening Post data from 'em...
zh: 我把其他数据板也查了。又从里面弄出些监听哨数据……

#en: [<Global=kgcShip_GLOB_Satellite_RevealCost> Credits] I'll pay for the information.
zh: [<Global=kgcShip_GLOB_Satellite_RevealCost>信用点] 我出钱买情报。

#en: Well, look at you! Hahaha! Hah. Now that's what I call "thinking outside the box"!
zh: 哟，瞧瞧你！哈哈哈！哈。这才叫「跳出框框思考」！

#en: ...I'm gonna pass on that one. But I'm sure whatever you said was very insightful!
zh: ……这个我就不接了。但我相信你说的话很有见地！

#en: Keep that mech in mind! When it surfaces, I'll be primed and ready to take it out.
zh: 记着那台机甲！它一露面，我就蓄势待发干掉它。

#en: But outside of fighting and salvaging Watchtower ships, it's hard tech to come by.
zh: 但除了打捞和战斗夺取瞭望塔的飞船，这技术很难搞到。

#en: And we also know what's waiting for us on Eridani III -- big old Watchtower Mechs.
zh: 我们还知道波江座III上等着我们的是什么——巨大的瞭望塔机甲。

#en: Uh, who am I...? Is-- Is that what you asked? Well, don't worry. I'm here to help!
zh: 呃，我是谁……？你——你是问这个吗？嗯，别担心。我是来帮忙的！

#en: B.A.B.S can't regulate the station's power core. You know, the unstable power core.
zh: B.A.B.S. 无法调节站里的动力核心。你知道，那个不稳定的动力核心。

#en: Neuroamp research is a relatively new discipline. Have you worked with them before?
zh: 神经增幅器研究是相对较新的学科。你以前接触过吗？

#en: I hate to disappoint, but you don't have enough Computer Cores for this extraction.
zh: 不想让你失望，但你的计算机核心不够做这次提取。

#en: Before we start slicing anything open, you might want to see what we can extract...
zh: 在我们开刀之前，你也许想看看能提取出什么……

#en: Opportunities dried up, credits ran low. That's when I was approached by someone...
zh: 机会枯竭，钱也见底。就在那时有人找上了我……

#en: ...I can't fault your straightforward thinking! Just cut the power. Genius, really!
zh: ……你这直来直去的思路我挑不出毛病！直接切断电源。真是天才！

#en: I mean, sure! That's one way to deal with it. I mean, if it works, it works, right?
zh: 当然！这也是一种办法。管用就行，对吧？

#en: All thanks to you! You're not half bad at this whole "thinking on your feet" thing!
zh: 全靠你！你这「随机应变」的本事还真不赖！

#en: Surprise! Didn't think I'd make it here so quick, huh? C'mon! I'll help you search.
zh: 惊喜！没想到我这么快就到了吧？来吧！我帮你找。

#en: No need for you to stick around! Head into the facility and grab that Control Node!
zh: 你不用留在这儿！进设施去，把那个控制节点拿到手！

#en: The Advocate delivered the goods, per usual. Control Node secure and accounted for!
zh: 辩护者一如既往地送到了货。控制节点已到手，清点无误！

#en: At the very least, it should help us keep track of how many Unity jumps we've made.
zh: 至少它能帮我们记录做过多少次归一跳跃。

#en: So find the Control Node, get back to Stardock, and my friends there will help you.
zh: 所以找到控制节点，回到星坞，我在那儿的朋友会帮你。

#en: Backup inbound. Don't forget to say "thanks", machines have feelings too! ...maybe.
zh: 增援抵达。别忘了说「谢谢」，机器也有感情！……也许吧。

#en: If you're asking why I'm interested in the data... Well, let's just say I'm curious.
zh: 你要问我为什么对数据感兴趣……嗯，就说我好奇吧。

#en: After all, B.A.B.S can't regulate the station's power core. The unstable power core.
zh: 毕竟，B.A.B.S. 无法调节站里的动力核心。那个不稳定的动力核心。

#en: [<Global=kgcShip_GLOB_Gren_CoreUpgradeCost> Computer Cores] Yes, that's what I want.
zh: [<Global=kgcShip_GLOB_Gren_CoreUpgradeCost>计算机核心] 对，我要的就是这个。

#en: Or maybe I just feel sorry for you! You know, you being such a charity case and all.
zh: 又或者我只是可怜你！你知道，你这种处处求人的处境。

#en: Here's what I got, but don't expect gourmet. This is Stardock, not some Ryujin caf�.
zh: 这是我有的，别指望美食。这儿是星坞，不是龙神咖啡馆。

#en: It's still quiet here, but that's okay. Everything worth building takes time, right?
zh: 这儿还是很安静，但没关系。值得建的东西都需要时间，对吧？

#en: It's nice that more folks have started showing up. Makes the place feel less lonely.
zh: 开始有更多人来这儿了，挺好的。这地方没那么冷清了。

#en: Oh, and those other slates you handed over? They also gave up some Post locations...
zh: 哦，还有你交来的那些数据板？它们也给出了些监听哨位置……

#en: I'll get the wheels turning, but it could take a while. You'll have to be patient...
zh: 我这就去张罗，但可能要花些时间。你得耐心点……

#en: I didn't know you had those sorta hacking skills! Good to know for future reference.
zh: 我不知道你还有这种黑客本事！记下了，以后有用。

#en: As soon as I'm low enough, I'll Grav Shift out. Chances are, I'll end up miles away.
zh: 我一降到足够低就重力位移出去。很可能落在几英里之外。

#en: First, we'll need that Fleet-Sync Control Node again. If you're ready to get moving?
zh: 首先，我们又需要那个舰队同步控制节点。你准备好出发了吗？

#en: Hah. Heh... Guess I do have some explaining to do... Um... But -- not here, not now.
zh: 哈。嘿……看来我确实有些事要解释……呃……但——不是这儿，不是现在。

#en: I couldn't tell you why, but Watchtower has been keeping tabs on you. For some time.
zh: 我说不清为什么，但瞭望塔一直在盯着你。有一段时间了。

#en: Look at you, still making life interesting. Ugh, good thing I don't mind saving you.
zh: 瞧瞧你，还是这么会折腾。唉，好在我救你也不嫌烦。

#en: ...Oh. I... suppose so. I just wanted to show I'm no threat, to help put you at ease.
zh: ……哦。我……想是吧。我只是想表明我没威胁，好让你放心。
